integrity: Exact spacings proof and finite-sample rank identity; standard-library exact-rational checker is supplemental and not an infinite proof.
scientific_limitations: Proved for independent common-rate exponential samples and the unnormalized Gini mean difference. Maximizing rank proportion is asymptotic; no all-size uniqueness of finite maximizers. Historical L-statistic identities may encode the calculation; independent audit and historical priority review not performed.
title: An asymptotically optimal exponential-sample quantile for Gini mean-difference correlation
